title: SSH brute force detected
description: At least 5 SSH failures from the same IP to the same host within 300 seconds (inclusive).

title: Suspicious PowerShell detected
description: PowerShell/pwsh command line contains EncodedCommand, hidden window, or a Defender exclusion change.

title: TCP port scan detected
description: TCP SYN from one source to at least 5 destination IPs or 5 ports on one destination within 60 seconds (inclusive).
